scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: IGNOAPS, under the National Social Assistance Programme, provides a monthly non-contributory pension to destitute senior citizens from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households, with central assistance topped up by most state governments.

eligibility.domicile: Indian citizen, resident of the applicant's state
eligibility.income_limit: Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
other_conditions: Applicant should have no regular source of income or family support
eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 60 years of age

benefits.maintenance_allowance: ₹200/month central assistance (age 60-79) or ₹500/month (age 80+); most states add a top-up, with combined amounts ranging from roughly ₹600 to ₹3,500/month depending on the state

application.application_mode: Online via the NSAP portal / SAMBAL app, or through the local Gram Panchayat or Municipal office
application_steps: Visit nsap.nic.in or the SAMBAL mobile app
Register with Aadhaar and bank account details
Select the applicable pension scheme for your state
Submit BPL and age-proof documents
Application is verified by the local body before sanction

target_students: Senior citizens aged 60+ from BPL households across India
ai_metadata.searchable_text: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme provides a monthly pension to destitute BPL senior citizens aged 60 and above across India, with higher amounts for those aged 80 and above, topped up by state governments.

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (implemented via ALIMCO)
description: RVY provides free assisted-living devices — walking sticks, wheelchairs, hearing aids, spectacles, artificial dentures and more — to BPL/low-income senior citizens suffering from age-related disability or infirmity, distributed through camps organised by ALIMCO (Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India).

eligibility.disability: Age-related disability or infirmity requiring an assisted-living device
eligibility.income_limit: Monthly income not exceeding ₹15,000, or belonging to a BPL household
eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 60 years of age

other_benefits: Free assisted-living devices: walking sticks, elbow crutches, walkers, tripods/quadpods, wheelchairs, hearing aids, artificial dentures, spectacles

application.application_mode: Camp-based distribution organised through district administration / ALIMCO camps
application_steps: Register interest through the district social welfare office or an RVY camp notification
Attend the assessment camp for a medical evaluation of device requirement
Devices are fitted and distributed free of cost at the camp

target_students: BPL/low-income senior citizens aged 60+ needing assistive devices
ai_metadata.searchable_text: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana provides free walking sticks, wheelchairs, hearing aids and other assisted-living devices to low-income senior citizens aged 60 and above with age-related disability, distributed via ALIMCO camps.

scheme_name: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card (AB PM-JAY for Senior Citizens 70+)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Launched in October 2024 as an extension of Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, this scheme gives every Indian aged 70 and above free health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per year, regardless of income, covering around 2,000 medical procedures with no waiting period for pre-existing conditions.

eligibility.income_limit: No income limit — open to all senior citizens aged 70 and above
eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 70 years of age

other_benefits: ₹5 lakh/year free health cover per household
Covers ~2,000 medical procedures at empanelled hospitals, no waiting period for pre-existing conditions

application.application_mode: Online via the Ayushman App or PM-JAY portal, or at empanelled hospitals and Common Service Centres
application_steps: Download the Ayushman App or visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in
Verify identity with Aadhaar
Complete e-KYC to generate the Ayushman Vay Vandana Card
Present the card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment

target_students: All Indian senior citizens aged 70 and above, regardless of income
ai_metadata.searchable_text: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card gives every senior citizen aged 70 and above free health insurance cover of Rs 5 lakh per year regardless of income, covering about 2000 procedures with no waiting period for pre-existing conditions.

department: Local Self Government Department / Information Kerala Mission, Government of Kerala
description: Sevana is Kerala's online social-security pension system, disbursing a monthly welfare pension to elderly, widowed and destitute residents through local self-government institutions across the state.

eligibility.income_limit: Annual family income below the state-prescribed welfare-pension threshold
eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 60 years of age

benefits.maintenance_allowance: Monthly welfare pension disbursed through the local self-government institution

application.application_mode: Online through the local self-government institution (Panchayat/Municipality/Corporation) or Akshaya centres
application_steps: Approach the local self-government office or an Akshaya e-service centre
Submit age, income and residence proof
Application is verified and entered into the Sevana pension system
Pension is disbursed monthly on approval

target_students: Elderly, widowed and destitute residents of Kerala aged 60+
ai_metadata.searchable_text: Sevana Social Welfare Pension provides a monthly pension to elderly, widowed and destitute residents of Kerala aged 60 and above, administered through local self-government institutions.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Old Age Pension Scheme (CMOAP)
department: Commissionerate of Revenue Administration and Disaster Management, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: A monthly financial-assistance pension for destitute elderly residents of Tamil Nadu with no other means of support, administered by the Revenue Department through Taluk offices.

other_conditions: Applicant must be destitute with no regular means of support
eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 60 years of age

application.application_mode: Offline — apply in person at the nearest Taluk/Revenue office
application_steps: Obtain the application form from the local Taluk office
Attach age, income and residence proof
Submit to the Taluk office for verification
Village Administrative Officer/Revenue Inspector conducts a field verification

target_students: Destitute senior citizens aged 60+ resident in Tamil Nadu
ai_metadata.searchable_text: Tamil Nadu Old Age Pension Scheme provides Rs 1200 per month to destitute senior citizens aged 60 and above resident in Tamil Nadu, applied through the local Taluk office.

department: Department of Social Welfare, Government of NCT of Delhi
description: A monthly financial-assistance pension for eligible senior citizens resident in Delhi, with a higher amount for those aged 70 and above.

eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 60 years of age

application.application_mode: Online via the e-District Delhi portal, or through the District Social Welfare Office
application_steps: Register/login on edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in
Fill the old-age pension application form
Upload age, residence and income proof
Submit for verification by the District Social Welfare Office

target_students: Senior citizens aged 60+ resident in Delhi
ai_metadata.searchable_text: Delhi Old Age Pension Scheme provides Rs 2500 to Rs 3000 per month to senior citizens aged 60 and above resident in Delhi, applied through the e-District Delhi portal.

scheme_name: Shravan Bal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana (Maharashtra)
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
description: A state old-age pension scheme for destitute senior citizens in Maharashtra with no regular source of income, administered by the Social Justice and Special Assistance Department.

eligibility.domicile: Resident of Maharashtra for at least 15 years
eligibility.income_limit: Annual family income below ₹21,000, or belonging to a BPL household
eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 65 years of age

application.application_mode: Offline — apply at the local Talathi office or the Block/District Social Justice and Special Assistance office
application_steps: Obtain the application form from the Talathi or Social Justice office
Attach age, income/BPL and 15-year residence proof
Submit for verification

target_students: Destitute senior citizens aged 65+ resident in Maharashtra for 15+ years
ai_metadata.searchable_text: Shravan Bal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana provides Rs 1500 per month to destitute senior citizens aged 65 and above who have lived in Maharashtra for at least 15 years and have annual income below Rs 21,000.

scheme_name: Jai Bangla Old Age Pension Scheme (West Bengal)
department: Women & Child Development and Social Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal
description: A monthly old-age pension for senior citizens resident in West Bengal, disbursed under the state's unified Jai Bangla pension platform.

eligibility.income_limit: BPL card holder or income certificate as prescribed by the scheme
eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 60 years of age

application.application_mode: Online via wbpension.net, or at Duare Sarkar camps / the local Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body office
application_steps: Visit wbpension.net or a Duare Sarkar camp
Fill the application with age, income/BPL and bank details
Submit at the Gram Panchayat/Urban Local Body office for verification

target_students: Senior citizens aged 60+ resident in West Bengal
ai_metadata.searchable_text: Jai Bangla Old Age Pension Scheme provides Rs 1000 per month to senior citizens aged 60 and above resident in West Bengal, applied via wbpension.net or Duare Sarkar camps.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: IGNWPS provides a monthly non-contributory pension to widows aged 40–79 years from BPL households. On turning 80, the beneficiary transitions to the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) at the higher 80+ rate. The central assistance is Rs 300/month, topped up by most state governments.

eligibility.income_limit: Must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
eligibility.age: 40 years and above (applicable from age 60 for senior citizen matching)

benefits.description: Rs 300/month central assistance; most states add a top-up, bringing combined total to Rs 500–2500/month depending on the state

application.application_mode: Apply via NSAP portal or local Gram Panchayat / Municipal office
application_steps: Visit nsap.nic.in or local Gram Panchayat
Submit widow proof (husband's death certificate) along with BPL and age proof
Local body verifies and sanctions the pension

ai_metadata.searchable_text: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme IGNWPS provides Rs 300 per month to widowed women from BPL households aged 40 and above through NSAP. Central assistance topped up by states.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: IGNDPS provides a monthly non-contributory pension to persons with severe or multiple disabilities aged 18–79 years from BPL households. Senior citizens with severe disability who are BPL qualify directly. The central assistance is Rs 300/month, usually topped up by states.

eligibility.income_limit: Must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
eligibility.disability: required — severe disability (80%+ certified) or multiple disabilities

benefits.description: Rs 300/month central assistance; states add top-up

application.application_mode: Apply via NSAP portal or Gram Panchayat / Municipal office
application_steps: Visit nsap.nic.in
Submit disability and BPL documents
Local body verifies and sanctions

ai_metadata.searchable_text: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme IGNDPS provides Rs 300 per month to BPL senior citizens with severe disability 80 percent or more aged 18 to 79 through NSAP.

description: Karnataka's Sandhya Suraksha Scheme provides a monthly pension of Rs 1,200 to senior citizens aged 60 and above who are Karnataka domicile holders from BPL families. SC/ST applicants may apply from age 55. The pension is credited directly to the bank account.

eligibility.income_limit: BPL household (family income below ₹1,50,000 per annum)
eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 65 years of age

benefits.description: Rs 1,200/month state pension, DBT to bank account

application.application_mode: Apply via Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in) or nearest Gram Panchayat / BBMP ward office
application_steps: Visit sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in
Register with Aadhaar
Apply for Sandhya Suraksha pension
Upload all required documents
Verification by taluk-level social welfare officer

ai_metadata.searchable_text: Karnataka Sandhya Suraksha pension scheme Rs 1200 per month to senior citizens 60 plus from BPL families with Karnataka domicile. SC ST eligible from 55 years. Apply at sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in.

scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Old Age Pension (Vriddhavasta Pension Yojana)
description: The Uttar Pradesh Old Age Pension Scheme provides Rs 1,000 per month to senior citizens aged 60 and above who are UP residents with annual income below Rs 46,080 (rural) or Rs 56,460 (urban). Pension is credited quarterly to the bank account via DBT.

eligibility.income_limit: Annual income below Rs 46,080 (rural) or Rs 56,460 (urban)
other_conditions: Not receiving any other government pension

benefits.description: Rs 1,000/month (paid quarterly), DBT to bank account

application.application_mode: Online at sspy-up.gov.in or nearest District Social Welfare Office
application_steps: Visit sspy-up.gov.in
Click 'Apply for Old Age Pension'
Fill form with personal, bank, and income details
Upload required documents
Track status on portal

ai_metadata.searchable_text: Uttar Pradesh Vriddhavasta Old Age Pension Rs 1000 per month to UP residents 60 plus with income below Rs 46080 rural or Rs 56460 urban. Apply at sspy-up.gov.in.

scheme_name: Rajasthan Chief Minister Old Age Pension Yojana
department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Rajasthan
description: Rajasthan's Chief Minister Old Age Pension Yojana provides Rs 1,450 per month to senior citizens aged 58 (men) or 55 (women) and above with annual income below Rs 48,000. The scheme is one of India's more inclusive, with a relatively low income ceiling and early qualifying age for women.

eligibility.age: Applicants must be above 58 years of age (women above 55 years of age)

application.application_mode: Online via SSO Rajasthan (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) or Ration Card Shop / Emitra
application_steps: Visit sso.rajasthan.gov.in or nearest Emitra centre
Login/register with SSO ID
Apply under Social Security Pension
Upload documents and submit

ai_metadata.searchable_text: Rajasthan Chief Minister Old Age Pension Yojana provides Rs 1450 per month to senior citizens aged 58 and above (55 for women) with annual income below Rs 48,000.

department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat
description: Gujarat's Vrudh Sahay pension provides Rs 1,000 per month (age 60-79) or Rs 1,250 per month (age 80+) to senior citizens who are Gujarat residents of at least 10 years, with annual family income below Rs 1,20,000 (rural) or Rs 1,50,000 (urban). Delivered through the e-Samaj Kalyan portal.

eligibility.income_limit: Annual family income below ₹1,20,000 in rural areas or ₹1,50,000 in urban areas
other_conditions: Permanent resident of Gujarat for at least 10 years

benefits.description: Rs 400–500/month state pension; additional top-up for certain categories

application.application_mode: Online via esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in or District Social Welfare Office
application_steps: Visit esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in
Apply for Vruddha Sahay Pension
Upload documents
District-level verification and sanction

ai_metadata.searchable_text: Gujarat Vrudh Sahay Yojana provides Rs 1000 to Rs 1250 per month to senior citizens aged 60 and above, resident in Gujarat for 10+ years, with annual income below Rs 1.2 lakh (rural) or Rs 1.5 lakh (urban).

scheme_name: Andhra Pradesh NTR Pension — Old Age Pension
department: Women Development and Child Welfare Department, AP
description: Andhra Pradesh's NTR Bharosa pension scheme provides Rs 4,000 per month to senior citizens aged 65 and above who are destitute, with monthly income up to Rs 10,000 (rural) or Rs 12,000 (urban) — one of India's higher state-level old age pensions. Delivered via Village/Ward Secretariats and the sspensions.ap.gov.in portal.

eligibility.income_limit: Monthly income up to ₹10,000 in rural areas or ₹12,000 in urban areas, and not already receiving another government pension (urban applicants)

benefits.description: Rs 2,750/month (age 65–79) or Rs 3,000/month (age 80+); one of India's highest state senior pensions

application.application_mode: Apply via nearest Village Secretariat or Ward Secretariat in AP
application_steps: Visit nearest Village/Ward Secretariat
Submit application form with BPL, age, and domicile documents
Verified by Tahsildar; pension starts within 30 days

ai_metadata.searchable_text: Andhra Pradesh NTR Bharosa old age pension provides Rs 4000 per month to destitute senior citizens aged 65 and above, delivered via Village/Ward Secretariats.

scheme_name: Telangana Aasara Pension — Old Age Pension
description: Telangana's Aasara pension provides Rs 4,000 per month to senior citizens aged 61 (men) or 57 (women) and above from BPL families. Pensions are delivered via Village Revenue Officers and credited directly to bank accounts.

application.application_mode: Apply at nearest Mee Seva centre or Village Revenue Office (VRO)
application_steps: Visit nearest Mee Seva centre or VRO
Submit application with BPL, age, and residence documents
Verified by MRO; pension credited monthly

ai_metadata.searchable_text: Telangana Aasara pension provides Rs 4000 per month to BPL senior citizens aged 61 and above (57 for women), delivered via Village Revenue Officers.
